title: Agedashi tofu

method.title: Make the sauce
method.body: Bring the dashi, mirin and soy to a simmer, then remove from the heat.

method.title: Drain the tofu
method.body:
Drain the tofu on a double layer of kitchen paper with another double layer on top. Place a plate on top & drain for 15 mins.
Trim the edges & cut into 4 pieces.

method.title: Heat the oil
method.body: Heat the oil to 180°C. Carefully roll each piece of tofu in flour.

method.title: Fry the tofu
method.body: Fry for 3-4 minutes until crisp & puffed up. Drain on a wire rack.

method.title: Arrange and top
method.body: Arrange tofu in a deep bowl & top with daikon, bonito, spring onion & ginger.

method.title: Pour the sauce
method.body:
Pour the hot sauce into each bowl around the edge.
Sprinkle with togarashi & serve.

note: She has written "yum yum" beside the sauce.

method.title: Salt and drain zucchini
method.body:
Shred zucchini & sprinkle with 2 tsp salt, then allow to sit in a strainer - 10 mins.
Squeeze liquid out of zucchini.

method.title: Make garlic paste
method.body: Chop garlic with a pinch of salt, then mash to a paste using a fork.

method.title: Mix the batter
method.body: Place zucchini, garlic paste, herbs, onion, egg, cheese & flour in a bowl. Mix well.

method.title: Heat the pan
method.body: In a large frypan, heat oil over medium heat.

method.title: Fry the fritters
method.body:
Drop 3 tbsp of zucchini mix in the pan & flatten with a spatula.
Continue with the remaining mixture & cook for 2-3 mins until golden brown, then turn & cook for another 2-3 mins.

method.title: Drain and serve
method.body: Drain on paper towel. Serve while warm.

title: Banh xeo pancakes

method.title: Make the batter
method.body: Combine the batter ingredients, cover & refrigerate for 30 mins.

method.title: Blanch the vegetables
method.body: Blanch the peas & carrot in boiling water for 2 mins. Refresh in cold water. Drain & toss with remaining vegetables.

method.title: Heat the pan
method.body: Heat 2 tsp of oil in a 20 cm non-stick frypan over medium heat.

method.title: Cook the pancakes
method.body:
Pour a quarter of the batter into the pan & swirl to evenly cover the base.
Cook for 4 mins or until golden.
Keep warm & repeat for the rest of the batter.

method.title: Fill and roll
method.body:
Top each pancake with salad, add chilli & drizzle with nuoc cham.
Roll & serve.

note: TIP: Add any vegetable you like plus seafood or roast pork.

title: Baked portobello mushrooms

items: 50 g oven roasted or sundried tomato

method.title: Make the stuffing
method.body:
Separate stalks from mushroom.
Chop & combine stalks, pine nuts, herbs, tomato & onion. Add breadcrumbs & drizzle oil. Just to combine.

method.title: Fill the mushrooms
method.body: Oil a flat oven tray, place mushroom caps skin side down, sprinkle with oil & salt & coat with mixture.

method.title: Bake
method.body: Cook at 180°C for 15 mins. Do not burn.

method.title: Make the sauce
method.body: In a pan over high heat boil the stock, cream & cheese, reducing to a thick consistency.

method.title: Serve
method.body: Place mushrooms on a plate, pour sauce over & garnish with rocket tossed in a little olive oil.

note: She titles the page "Baked portabella mushrooms ~ Fungi al forno". Beside the herbs she notes: ie a good handful of each herb.
serve_with: Rocket tossed in a little olive oil

title: Balinese corn fritters

items: 1 450 g can corn or 2 cobs (kernels removed)
2 tsp fresh turmeric - chopped (or 1 tsp dried turmeric)

method.title: Grind the spice paste
method.body: Grind the spice paste in a mortar & pestle or grind in a food processor to a paste.

method.title: Mix the batter
method.body: Put the corn kernels in a bowl with the spice paste & stir in flour, eggs, lime leaves & salt.

method.title: Check consistency
method.body: Should be the consistency of a thick pancake. Add more flour if needed.

method.title: Fry the fritters
method.body:
Heat oil & fry 1 tablespoon at a time until golden brown. Approx 15 [?].
Drain on paper towel.

note: TIP: Double the spice paste for more oomph. Beside the oil she notes: coconut oil is good.
check: the '∴ 15' at the end of the frying step - no unit written, probably 'makes approx 15'

title: Cappuccino of mushroom

method.title: Froth the milk
method.body: Heat milk until almost boiling. Froth up using a hand blender. Rest for a few mins for froth to come to the top.

method.title: Cook the mushrooms
method.body: Heat oil and cook onion, garlic, salt & pepper and mushrooms for 6 mins till tender. Add tarragon.

method.title: Reduce the stock
method.body:
Reduce mushroom stock by two thirds.
Whisk the cream to ribbon stage (a figure 8 drawn on top should hold momentarily).

method.title: Finish the stock
method.body: Whisk cream into stock and bring to boil. Remove from heat & stir in milk froth. Season with juice & salt & pepper.

method.title: Assemble and serve
method.body:
Put mushroom mix into warmed serving bowls. (I use teacups) - approx 10.
Pour stock mix over mushrooms.
Top with a piece of truffle or truffle oil.

note: Titled on the page "BJ's ~ Cappuccino of mushroom". She writes: Delicious! Great amuse bouche.
check: quantity of truffle slices - reads as 10 but could be 40

title: Caramelised onion tart

items: 200 g fresh goats curd or Persian feta

method.title: Make the pastry
method.body:
Process flour, butter, 1/2 tsp salt & oil till just combined. Add egg and pulse till just forming a ball. Add a splash of iced water if needed.
Wrap in plastic & refrigerate for 1 hr.

method.title: Caramelise the onions
method.body: Heat oil & butter. Add onion & season well. Cook on low for 30 mins or until soft & golden. Add sugar & cook for 5 minutes.

method.title: Make the filling
method.body: Beat eggs & cream together & mix with onion, crumbled cheese & optional roasted garlic.

method.title: Assemble and bake
method.body:
Roll out pastry to a 25 cm flan tin with removable base.
Add filling & sprinkle with thyme leaves.
Bake at 200°C for 45 min till golden.

method.title: Optional roasted garlic
method.body: 3 garlic bulbs wrapped in foil & roasted at 200°C for 1 hr or until soft. Cool.

serve_with: Golden leaf salad dressed with red wine vinegar & olive oil

title: Chickpea & vegetable soup with anchovy & rosemary pesto

items: 4 litres vege stock (can use Vegeta stock powder)

method.title: Soak the chickpeas
method.body: Soak 2 C chickpeas in water overnight.

method.title: Sauté the aromatics
method.body: In a 5 litre stockpot sauté 1 lg chopped onion, 4 sliced garlic cloves in oil.

method.title: Add spice and stock
method.body: Add 2 tsp ground pimento or allspice, 4 litres of vege stock (can use Vegeta stock powder).

method.title: Add carrots and chickpeas
method.body:
Add 4 large carrots that are roughly chopped to the stock along with the chickpeas.
Simmer for 1 hour.

method.title: Add the potatoes
method.body: Add 4 large chopped potatoes and simmer till tender.

method.title: Make the pesto
method.body: Blend the rosemary, anchovy fillets, garlic, oil, salt & pepper till smooth.

method.title: Serve
method.body:
Dollop a tablespoon of pesto on each plate of soup.
Sluuurp.

note: Titled on the page "Chickpea & vegetable soup with rosemary & anchovy pesto ~ Heidi's".

items: 2 cans chickpeas or 200 g dried - rinsed & cooked for a further 15 mins in water with 1 tsp salt & 3/4 tsp cumin
1/2 tsp each of ground cumin, coriander, ginger, dry mustard, turmeric

method.title: Skin the chickpeas
method.body: Remove skins from chickpeas by tipping peas onto a large tea towel. Fold to a bag then gently but vigorously rub them until the skins loosen & fall off. Discard skins.

method.title: Blend till silky
method.body:
Place all ingredients into a food processor & run until very smooth and silky. If hummus is too thick add chickpea water.
Season with 2 1/2 tsp salt.

title: Crunchy spiced calamari with yoghurt sauce

method.title: Prepare the calamari
method.body: Split the calamari tubes lengthwise and score the inside with a diamond pattern using a sharp knife.

method.title: Spice the calamari
method.body: Sprinkle 5 teaspoons of the spice over the calamari & coat well.

method.title: Crumb and chill
method.body: Dust the calamari in cornflour, then egg & panko. Refrigerate.

method.title: Make the yoghurt sauce
method.body: Mix one teaspoon of spice with yoghurt & salt well.

method.title: Deep fry
method.body: Deep fry calamari till golden.

method.title: Plate up
method.body:
On a large serving platter, dop 1 tbsp yoghurt mix evenly around plate.
Place salad leaves down the middle & top with calamari. Serve with date paste.

items: chilli powder or fresh chilli to taste

method.title: Soak the lentils
method.body: Soak the lentils for 1 hour.

method.title: Fry and simmer
method.body: Fry lentils, onions, garlic & ginger till fragrant & add tomatoes if using or water to cover.

method.title: Mash and season
method.body: When lentils are soft mash & add salt & lemon juice & chilli to taste.

method.title: To make soup
method.body: For soup add more water or stock to reach desired consistency.

method.title: Garnish
method.body: Garnish with coriander & yoghurt.

title: Figs, ham & cheese · broad bean bruschetta

items: 6 slices (very thin) parma ham or prosciutto
approx 100 g taleggio or creamy blue cheese (white castello works well)

method.title: Open the figs
method.body: Slice each fig in quarters from the top to about halfway down. Gently squeeze the base of the fig so the leaves open like a flower.

method.title: Fill and wrap
method.body: Place a wedge of cheese in the middle of the fig & wrap the fig in one slice of ham.

method.title: Drizzle with maple
method.body: Drizzle the top with a little dollop of maple syrup.

method.title: Grill the figs
method.body: Place under a hot grill till the cheese begins to melt & the ham is brown on the top edge. Approx 2-3 mins.

method.title: Pound the broad beans
method.body: Place all ingredients in a mortar & pestle, except the oil, & pound until smooth. Add enough olive oil that the mix will take while still thick but not runny.

method.title: Serve the bruschetta
method.body: Serve on sliced toasted baguette.

serve_with: Sliced toasted baguette (for the broad bean bruschetta)

title: Cucumber relish & fish cakes

items: 3 tbsp coconut vinegar or wine vinegar

method.title: Make the relish syrup
method.body:
Combine vinegar, sugar, water + salt.
Bring to boil & dissolve sugar.
Cool. This can go in the fridge till needed.

method.title: Finish the relish
method.body:
Mix other ingredients & pour over syrup.
Good with fish cakes.

method.title: Blend the fish mix
method.body:
Blend the fish fillets, red curry paste and egg in a food processor or pound.
Season with the fish sauce and castor sugar.

method.title: Slap the mix
method.body: Gather the fish mix into a ball and throw into a bowl. Continue slapping the mix till it is firmer & stickier.

method.title: Add aromatics
method.body: Add 5 shredded kaffir lime leaves and 2 tbsp finely chopped beans.

method.title: Shape and fry
method.body: Mould into small discs & deep fry.

note: TIP: Use less curry paste for less spice/heat.
serve_with: Cucumber relish is good with fish cakes

title: Indonesian satay

items: 4 tbsp coconut cream (added when the sauce is needed)

method.title: Skewer the meat
method.body: Cut meat into strips & thread onto bamboo sticks.

method.title: Marinate
method.body: Combine marinade ingredients. Pour over skewers & marinate for at least 12 hours.

method.title: Start the satay sauce
method.body:
Brown onion in oil. Add garlic. Sauté & set aside.
Fry shrimp paste & chilli. Return onion & garlic to pan.

method.title: Finish the sauce
method.body: Add the remaining ingredients & cook together.

method.title: To serve
method.body:
You can store the satay sauce till you need it. When satay sauce is needed add:
4 tbsp coconut cream.
Taste and add more tamarind or sugar as required.

note: TIP: Use kecap manis for soy. Add some coconut cream for gado gado [?].
check: last two characters of the tip - 'for gado gado ic.' (possibly '1 C')

title: Jo's smoked trout pâté

method.title: Make the stock
method.body: Remove skin & bones from trout. Place head & skin in a pan, add water & wine. Simmer for 5 mins. Strain.

method.title: Add butter and gelatine
method.body: Return liquid to the pan & add butter & gelatine. Stir over low heat till dissolved.

method.title: Blitz the pâté
method.body: Blitz liquid & trout (a Ninja works well) till pureed.

method.title: Fold in sour cream
method.body: Fold in sour cream & season to taste.

method.title: Set overnight
method.body: Pour into 4 serving dishes & refrigerate overnight.

method.title: Serve
method.body:
Before serving, slice avocado if using & top with lemon juice.
Serve pâté & avocado with toast.

note: TIP: Add lemon juice to the pâté when making.

title: Prawn, sweet potato & zucchini spring rolls

method.title: Combine the filling
method.body:
Combine all the ingredients & mix well. Leave for 10-15 minutes to get to know each other.
Squeeze out excess moisture from potato & zucchini first.

method.title: Roll the spring rolls
method.body: Spoon small amounts onto spring roll wrappers, roll & seal edge with a flour/water slurry. Cover till needed.

method.title: Fry
method.body: Fry at 180°C till golden.

note: Opt: Add soaked fine rice noodle. Makes approx 24 rolls.

items: 1 butternut or 1/4 Kent pumpkin - seeded, skinned & chopped

method.title: Sauté the vegetables
method.body: Sauté the pumpkin, onion & ginger in a little oil or ghee for 4 mins. Add wakame & salt.

method.title: Simmer
method.body: Cover with stock or water. Simmer 35-40 mins.

method.title: Blend and finish
method.body:
Blend or mash pumpkin.
Check seasoning, add juice & soy. Simmer 5 minutes.

title: Quiche
serves: Fills one 18 cm pie tin x 4.5 cm

items: diced capsicum, olives, ricotta, parmesan, spinach

method.title: The base
method.body:
Make your own pastry (easy in a food processor) or buy a good quality shortcrust.
Using your hands, gently press the pastry into a metal pan.

method.title: Blind bake
method.body:
Prick the base with a fork & line with foil, pressing into edge.
Bake at 190°C for 15 mins.

method.title: Seal the base
method.body: Remove foil & brush with beaten egg to seal base. Bake without foil for a further 8 minutes.

method.title: The filling
method.body: Reduce heat to 180°C. Place filling in prepared base & top with egg/cream mix. Bake for 35 mins or until just set.

note: TIP: to make 3 quiches use 6 eggs + 600 ml cream.

method.title: Flatten the chicken
method.body:
Slice the chicken breast in half horizontally then in half again.
Place slices between cling wrap or baking paper & gently roll with a rolling pin till approx 1/2 cm thick.

method.title: Roll with seafood stick
method.body: Brush each slice with soy. Place one seafood stick on each slice and roll up firmly.

method.title: Wrap in spring roll pastry
method.body: Place roll diagonally on a spring roll wrapper. Fold in ends and roll securely. Seal the end with the water & flour mix.

method.title: Deep fry
method.body:
Deep fry for approx 3 mins until golden brown & cooked through.
In a wok is good. Drain well and cut into diagonal slices.

method.title: Serve
method.body: Serve with soy or favourite dipping sauce.

items: 1 small purple onion - seeded & finely diced

method.title: Chop to a paste
method.body:
Combine the lamb, tomato, onion, parsley, allspice, chilli & molasses on a large chopping board.
Using a large knife chop till you get a fine paste.

method.title: Fry the lamb
method.body:
Heat a splash of oil in a pan & fry lamb paste for 5 mins.
Stir continuously until well browned. Leave to cool slightly.

method.title: Brown the pine nuts
method.body: Brown pine nuts.

method.title: Assemble
method.body:
Heap hummus on a serving dish.
Scatter with lamb & then nuts.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.body: Drizzle over a little olive oil & serve with warm flatbread.

title: Twice baked three cheese soufflé — part 1

items: butter & flour to grease the ramekins

method.title: Infuse the milk
method.body: Bring milk & bay to a simmer. Season well. Remove from heat & infuse.

method.title: Prepare the ramekins
method.body: Grease the ramekins in an upward motion & flour well.

method.title: Make the cheese sauce
method.body:
Melt butter. Add flour. Cook till gold. Add milk and stir till sauce thickens & silky.
Add parmesan & chèvre - melt and [?].

method.title: Fold in the eggs
method.body:
Beat egg whites till medium peaks form.
Beat egg yolks into cheese sauce & gently fold in whites a third at a time.

method.title: Fill the ramekins
method.body: Spoon into ramekins running your thumb around the edge.

method.title: Bake in a bain marie
method.body: Place in a bain marie half way up the side of ramekin. Bake 180° for 20 mins till gold & risen.

method.title: Store
method.body:
Store in fridge covered for up to 3 days.
Go to Part 2.

check: ramekin size - reads '4 200g ramekins', possibly 200 ml
two or three words after 'Add parmesan & chèvre - melt and ...'

title: Twice baked three cheese soufflé — part 2

method.title: Turn out the soufflés
method.body: Heat oven to 200°C (fan forced). Run a knife around the soufflé & tip into a shallow baking dish, bowl or saucer.

method.title: Top with cream and cheese
method.body: Pour 1 tbsp of cream over each soufflé and top with grated gruyère or Comté.

method.title: Second bake
method.body: Bake for 10 mins or until the cheese is gold & bubbly. The soufflés will spring back to life.

method.title: Make the vinaigrette
method.body: Mix together well & toss through rocket, pear & hazelnut salad.

note: NOTE: oven must be HOT. Go to 220° if not fan forced.
serve_with: A rocket, pear & hazelnut salad with vinaigrette

title: Thai prawn, pumpkin & coconut soup

method.title: Fry the curry paste
method.body: Heat oil in saucepan, add garlic & curry paste & cook quickly on high for 1 min. Do not burn.

method.title: Add aromatics
method.body: Add chillies, lemongrass & shallot. Cook till shallots are soft.

method.title: Simmer the pumpkin
method.body: Add stock & pumpkin, cover & simmer for 10 mins. Stir in coconut cream & simmer for 5 mins or until pumpkin is soft.

method.title: Cook the prawns
method.body: Add prawns & cook till the prawn is pink.

method.title: Serve
method.body: Serve sprinkled with basil.

note: Credited at the bottom of the page: - Gaz & Deb -

title: Tom yum goong

items: 1 litre chicken stock or shells & heads from peeled prawns
2 tbsp or to taste - chilli jam

method.title: Make prawn stock
method.body: If using prawn heads for stock - crush in a mortar & pestle. Bring 1 litre water to boil. Add heads & shells. Stir then bring back to the boil. Remove & strain.

method.title: Boil the stock
method.body: Bring stock to the boil over medium heat.

method.title: Add aromatics and prawns
method.body:
Add shallots, lemongrass & galangal & return to the boil. Add prawn flesh, mushrooms, fish sauce & chilli jam.
Cook till prawns are just pink.

method.title: Strain out the aromatics
method.body: Remove from heat & take out lemongrass, galangal & shallots.

method.title: Finish and serve
method.body: Add rest of ingredients except coriander. Serve & garnish with coriander.

note: TIP: adjust heat by reducing chilli & chilli jam.

title: Beef & brussel sprout pasta

items: 400 g beef cut in stirfry strips

method.title: Infuse the oil
method.body: Gently heat oil and add garlic & pepper. Cover and cook on a very low heat for 10 mins. The garlic must not burn. Remove.

method.title: Sauté mushrooms and onion
method.body: Drain oil back to pan & sauté mushrooms & onions. Remove.

method.title: Sear the beef
method.body: Sauté sliced meat quickly in small batches. Remove.

method.title: Cook the greens
method.body: Sauté peas & sprouts, add a small amount to pan to help steam vegetables.

method.title: Bring it together
method.body: Return all ingredients to pan with cream & sauce. Add pasta and toss to combine.

note:
TIP: Use broccoli for brussel sprout.
TIP: Have pasta boiling at this stage (while the meat is being sautéed).

title: Cauliflower cheese & caramelised fennel

items: a splash of vermouth or Pernod

method.title: Make a white sauce
method.body: Make a white sauce with 2 fresh bay leaves & nutmeg.

method.title: Pour over cauliflower
method.body: Pour over blanched cauliflower florets in a buttered dish.

method.title: Sprinkle the topping
method.body: Sprinkle with roasted hazelnuts, panko crumbs & cheese. Either parmesan or gruyere.

method.title: Bake till golden
method.body: Bake @ 180°C for 20 mins or until golden brown.

method.title: Fennel: cut & trim
method.body: Cut fennel lengthways & trim. Reserve trimmings.

method.title: Fennel: brown the bulbs
method.body: Melt 1 tbsp butter & 1 tbsp olive oil in saute pan & brown/caramelise the fennel bulbs (till brown).

method.title: Fennel: bake with wine
method.body:
Place in oven with trimmings and a splash of vermouth or Pernod, 1/2 glass white wine.
Cover & bake till soft at 180°C, approximately 20 mins.

method.title: Fennel: strain the liquid
method.body: Remove fennel bulbs & strain liquid & trimming.

method.title: Fennel: add cream & parmesan
method.body: Return strained liquid to dish with fennel, 1/2 cup cream and small handful of grated parmesan.

method.title: Fennel: bake till bubbly
method.body: Bake till golden & bubbly. Enjoy!

title: Cara's eggplant lasagne

items: 2 large eggplant - sliced & salted for a minimum of 2 hrs. Rinsed & dried with paper towels. Dice.

method.title: Fry off the eggplant
method.body: Fry off eggplant in a decent amount of olive oil till caramelised & brown. Do not burn. Remove.

method.title: Fry the vegetables
method.body: In same pan fry onion, garlic and zucchini.

method.title: Simmer the sauce
method.body:
Add eggplant & tomato sauce. Sprinkle with oregano & season.
Simmer sauce for 30 mins or more till thickened. Add a good handful of fresh basil.

method.title: Layer the lasagne
method.body:
In a lasagne dish add a layer of eggplant sauce to coat bottom of dish. Then a layer of lasagne sheets. Then eggplant followed by a layer of bechamel & chunks of ricotta.
Continue layering and finish with grated cheese.

method.title: Bake
method.body: Bake at 180°C for 45-60 minutes.

title: Cauliflower kofta in tomato & korma sauce

items: 8 medium tomatoes, quartered, or 1 400 g can of whole tomatoes
ghee or oil for deep frying

method.title: Fry the spices
method.body: Heat oil & fry ginger & spice till aromatic. Add mustard seed till they start to crackle.

method.title: Simmer the tomato sauce
method.body: Add sugar, salt & tomatoes. Simmer until thick and sauce-like.

method.title: Process & roll the kofta
method.body: Process ingredients until combined. Roll into golf ball sized circles & deep fry until golden brown.

method.title: Serve the kofta
method.body: Serve kofta on cooked spaghetti with the tomato sauce.

note: Page heading reads "Cauliflower kofta in tomato ~ Kurma Dasa" - credited to Kurma Dasa. Written along the bottom of the page: "BEST VEGOBALLS ON TOP OF SPAGHETTI".
serve_with: Cooked spaghetti with the tomato sauce.

title: Chiang Mai noodle

method.title: Fry the curry paste
method.body: Mix boiled egg noodle. Put curry paste & powder & oil in wok & stir until fragrant.

method.title: Cook the chicken
method.body: Add chicken, 1/4 cup coconut milk & stir until chicken is cooked.

method.title: Finish the sauce
method.body: Add the remaining milk, fish sauce & sugar over medium heat.

method.title: Pour over the noodles
method.body: Pour over egg noodle & top with crispy noodle.

serve_with: Serve with pickled cabbage, lime, coriander & spring onion. Chilli oil is optional.

title: Chilled soba noodle with mushroom

items: 250 g shimeji, oyster, shiitake mushrooms or a mixture
1/4 cup lightly packed shredded nori, approximately 1 nori sheet sliced thinly

method.title: Steep the mushrooms
method.body:
Combine the dashi, soy, mirin & mushrooms in a small pot & bring to the boil.
Turn off heat & let mushrooms cool in the liquid.

method.title: Squeeze the daikon
method.body: Put the daikon radish on 2 layers of cheesecloth. Twist the cloth to form a pouch & squeeze excess water out of daikon.

method.title: Cook the soba
method.body:
Bring a pot of water to the boil & cook soba till cooked but not mushy. About 4 mins.
Drain & rinse in cold water. Drain well.

method.title: Divide between bowls
method.body: Divide soba between bowls. Using a slotted spoon divide mushrooms between bowls.

method.title: Top & dress
method.body:
Top with daikon, spring onion & nori.
Pour sauce over each bowl.

note: Page title is written "Chilled soba noodles with mushroom".

title: Christmas curry pasta salad

items: Box of penne pasta - cooked al dente
3-4 stalks celery - diced finely, including celery leaves

method.title: Mix the salad
method.body: Mix all ingredients, except eggs.

method.title: Add curry powder
method.body: Add curry powder to your taste (keep adding till you are happy with the flavour).

method.title: Fold the eggs through
method.body: Crush eggs & mix through last.

method.title: Bechamel: make a roux
method.body:
Melt butter in a medium sized pan over moderate heat. Add flour stirring all the time till a paste.
Cook roux for a few minutes.

method.title: Bechamel: finish the sauce
method.body: Add rest of ingredients & continue stirring till thick & silky.

note: "- from Cara -" written beside the salad ingredients. TIP: If you get lumps use a whisk & beat well.

title: Didi's easy fried rice

items: 4 cups smart rice (Doongara), cooked for 12 minutes & dried on tray in the fridge
2 cups vegetables - diced, eg. peas, carrot, corn, celery

method.title: Fry the eggs
method.body: Lightly beat the eggs. Fry in the wok. Remove & roll up and slice into 1 cm strips.

method.title: Fry onion & ham
method.body: Heat oil in wok till hot. Lightly fry onion. Add ham & fry 1 min [?].

method.title: Stir fry the vegetables
method.body: Add vegetables & stir fry over high heat.

method.title: Colour the rice
method.body: Sprinkle rice with soy sauce till lightly coloured & add to wok.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.body: Add eggs & prawns & toss in wok to combine & heat rice through. Serve.

note: Prepare all ingredients in advance.
check: "fry 1 mm." - read as 'fry 1 min'

title: Farro & roast pumpkin salad

items: 600 g pumpkin, skinned & cut in thin wedges

method.title: Cook the farro
method.body:
Cover the farro with plenty of water, bring to the boil & simmer 15 mins. Drain.
While farro is warm, stir in the sherry & 1 tbsp oil.

method.title: Roast pumpkin & onion
method.body:
Cut onion into wedges, trimming root but leaving enough intact so onion stays intact.
Coat pumpkin & onion in 1 tbsp oil then roast at 200°C on a tray lined with baking paper & seasoned with chilli & salt & pepper. Cook for 30-40 mins till tender.

method.title: Make the dressing
method.body: Place remaining oil, juice & salt & pepper in a jar and shake well.

method.title: Combine & dress
method.body: Combine farro, roasted vegetables, green onion & coriander & dress.

method.title: Finish with feta
method.body: Sprinkle with danish feta on top.

note: Signed "Heidi".

title: Garlic mashed potato & lentil patties

items: 500 g brown lentils - soaked in water overnight & cooked till soft, or 1 can lentils

method.title: Boil the potatoes
method.body: Boil your potatoes. Remove from saucepan.

method.title: Make the cream base
method.body: Add a big knob of butter, 125 ml of thickened cream, freshly crushed garlic & parsley to pan. Season very well.

method.title: Mash the potatoes
method.body: When cream & butter have thickened, add potatoes & mash.

method.title: Patties: mix the base
method.body: Mix all above together then add 1 egg & flour until the mix sticks together & you can roll balls.

method.title: Patties: shape & fry
method.body:
Keep hands well floured when making balls.
Flatten to patty shape and shallow fry in oil till crispy brown.

note:
Mashed potato is headed "- Shaun -"; the lentil patties are credited "CARA".
TIP (mash): Do a large batch of mash & put in dariole moulds. Cling wrap & freeze portions. When needed thaw & reheat each portion in microwave for 1 minute.
TIP (patties): Add 1 tbsp grated ginger.
check: "125 gml of thickened cream" - read as 125 ml
no quantities are written for the potatoes themselves

items: 1/2 cup unsalted roasted peanuts - chopped roughly

method.title: Simmer the potatoes
method.body:
Cut the potatoes into thick slices. Place in medium pan, cover with water.
Simmer 6 mins or until just tender. Drain & cool.

method.title: Blanch carrots & beans
method.body:
Cut carrots into thick slices, top & tail beans & cut into 4 cm lengths.
Bring a pot of water to the boil. Add carrots & beans. Cook for 2-3 mins.
Drain & plunge into iced water. Drain.

method.title: Blanch the cabbage
method.body: Blanch cabbage for 20 seconds in boiling water. Cool in iced water. Drain.

method.title: Arrange the platter
method.body:
Cut eggs into quarters or halves. Arrange over all the ingredients on a platter.
Cover & refrigerate.

title: Gaz's dairy free potato bake

method.title: Preheat the oven
method.body: Preheat the oven to 170°C & have a baking tray ready to go.

method.title: Blend the cashew creme
method.body: Combine cashews & water & blend until completely smooth.

method.title: Mix everything together
method.body: Mix all ingredients + cashew creme in a bowl. Season.

method.title: Transfer & sprinkle
method.body: Transfer mix to a greased baking tray. Sprinkle with extra paprika.

method.title: Bake covered
method.body: Cover with foil & bake for 45-60 mins until fork tender.

method.title: Rest & serve
method.body: Leave to rest for 8 mins then serve.

note: (also gluten free)

title: Balinese base wangen marinade & green coconut salad

ingredients.group: Balinese base wangen - marinade for meat/tofu

items: 2 cups blanched chopped greens (spinach, fern, asian green)

method.title: Pound the marinade
method.body: In a mortar pound together the spices listed above.

method.title: Salad: roast the coconut
method.body: Roast either fresh coconut over a flame or dried in a pan.

method.title: Salad: mix the sambal
method.body:
Mix sambal goreng, shredded lime leaves, sliced kaffir lime with roasted coconut.
Bruise heartily.

method.title: Salad: combine with greens
method.body: Mix with leaves. Add sea salt to taste & a little water if necessary.

note: A "My favourite" sticker is pasted between the two recipes. The salad is headed "Green coconut salad".

title: Green papaya salad

items: 4 snake beans - cut in 3 cm length
200 g shredded papaya (or carrot or cucumber)

method.title: Pound the garlic
method.body: Using a large mortar & pestle pound the garlic into a paste.

method.title: Add peanuts & chilli
method.body: Add peanuts, chilli & dried prawn & pound till mixed with garlic.

method.title: Add the vegetables
method.body: Gently pounding, add the beans, palm sugar, tomato & papaya.

method.title: Add the dressing
method.body: Add the tamarind water, lime juice & fish sauce.

method.title: Infuse the flavours
method.body: Lightly pound & mix for a further minute, for all the flavours to infuse.

method.title: Serve
method.body: Serve with lime wedges.

note: TIP: Pieces of fresh pineapple can be added at the * (she marks the * at the end of the step where the tamarind water, lime juice & fish sauce go in).

title: Hainanese chicken rice — part 1

items: 1 chicken, approximately 1.5 kg, at room temperature
coriander, sliced cucumber & sliced spring onion to serve

method.title: Poach the chicken
method.body:
Trim any visible fat from the chicken and retain. Put garlic & 5 slices of ginger inside chicken cavity & place chicken in a large pan breast-side down.
Cover with water and bring to a low simmer. Simmer for 25 mins.

method.title: Rest off the heat
method.body: Cover the pot & turn off the heat. Leave for 30 minutes & lift chicken out of poaching stock.

method.title: Oil & chill the chicken
method.body: Brush chicken skin with sesame oil. Cover with cling wrap & refrigerate.

method.title: Cut & dress to serve
method.body:
To serve chicken cut chinese style & dress with 1 tbsp sesame oil, 2 tbsp soy & 80 ml chicken stock.
Garnish with condiments, cucumber etc.

method.title: Chicken rice: render the fat
method.body: Put chicken fat in saucepan & render fat over low heat for 1 hour.

method.title: Chicken rice: fry the aromatics
method.body: Add 1 tbsp chicken fat to a saucepan & saute till fragrant remaining garlic & ginger.

note: Headed "- Two asian kitchens -". Page title is written "Hainese chicken rice". OPT: Serve chilli sauce with chicken along with onion & ginger oil. Marked "CONT →" at the foot of the page.
serve_with: Coriander, sliced cucumber & sliced spring onion.

title: Hainanese chicken rice — part 2

method.title: Toast the rice
method.body: Add rice to pan and toss till well coated & opaque.

method.title: Add stock & seasoning
method.body: Add 1.25 litres of reserved chicken stock, the salt & soy sauce.

method.title: Simmer uncovered
method.body: Bring to simmer, uncovered & cook for approximately 5 mins until the water/stock is level with the top of the rice & tunnels appear in the top of the rice where steam is escaping.

method.title: Steam with the lid on
method.body: Put on a tight fitting lid. Reduce heat to very low & leave for 10 mins.

method.title: Fluff the rice
method.body: Remove lid and use a moistened rice paddle or wooden spoon to fluff the rice.

method.title: Oil: pound the aromatics
method.body: Put onion, ginger & salt in a heat proof mortar & pound lightly.

method.title: Oil: pour over hot oil
method.body: Heat the oil until smoking and pour over onion mixture.

method.title: Oil: combine & infuse
method.body:
Once sizzling stops combine gently with pestle & leave to infuse for a few minutes.
Serve with chicken & rice.

note:
Headed "CONT:".
ALT: Fry rice first & transfer to rice cooker.
TIP: Left over chicken stock can be served as a light broth with spring onions.

title: Heidi's paella

items: 5 [?] chicken thighs cut in 4 cm chunks

method.title: Fry the chorizo
method.body: Fry 2 chorizo (sliced) for less than a minute. Set aside.

method.title: Fry the squid
method.body: Fry 3 sliced squid tubes for less than a minute. Set aside.

method.title: Fry the chicken
method.body: Fry 5 [?] chicken thighs cut in 4 cm chunks.

method.title: Add the vegetables
method.body: Add 1/2 cup peas, handful of chopped beans, 1 chopped onion, 1/2 chopped green capsicum & 1/2 cup fresh parsley in 4 tbsp olive oil.

method.title: Add spice & tomato
method.body: Add spice mix, 1 tsp tomato paste + 1 or 2 fresh chopped tomatoes.

method.title: Heat the stock
method.body: Heat 6 cups of good quality chicken stock.

method.title: Add the rice
method.body: Add 3 cups of spanish rice to the frypan in a cross.

method.title: Add stock & chorizo
method.body: Add the stock & chorizo and stir from the outside in.

method.title: Cook on the BBQ
method.body: Place in a hot BBQ with lid down for 10 mins.

method.title: Add the shellfish
method.body: Then add 1/2 kg green prawns, head down into the rice. Poke in cleaned mussels. Close lid for 3 minutes.

method.title: Finish with squid
method.body: Add squid and sliced pimentos and cook for 2 mins. Serve with lemon/parsley.

check: number of chicken thighs - written like a '5' but could be a '3'

title: Honeymoon spaghetti with seafood

method.title: Sauce: fry the crab
method.body: Heat oil gently and fry crab, garlic and chilli, season. Do not let the garlic burn.

method.title: Sauce: simmer & strain
method.body:
Add tomatoes and simmer for 1 hr. Add water if sauce reduces too much.
Strain and remove any meat from crabs.

method.title: Topping: cook the seafood
method.body:
Heat oil & butter. Increase heat and add prawns, mussel & squid.
Deglaze with 1/2 cup white wine and cover. Cook until mussels just open.

method.title: Cook the spaghetti
method.body: While making sauce and topping, cook 500 g spaghetti in a large pan with well salted water until just al dente.

method.title: Combine & serve
method.body:
Combine spaghetti, sauce & topping in a large serving bowl. Add some pasta water to loosen.
Sprinkle with herbs.

note: Page title is written "Honeymoon spaghetti".

title: Jewelled rice — part 1

items: zest of 2 mandarins or oranges - blanched to remove bitterness
50 g castor sugar + 100 ml water + blanched zest. Simmer 10 mins. Reserve syrup & zest separately.
2 tbsp dried barberries - soaked in water for 2 mins then drained. Heat 30 g unsalted butter, add barberries & cook over a gentle heat 4-5 mins.

method.title: Soak the rice
method.body:
Wash the rice thoroughly & leave to soak in lukewarm water for 30 mins.
Strain the rice & rinse with lukewarm water.

method.title: Par-cook the rice
method.body:
Bring more water to the boil & salt. Add rice & cook for 5 mins then drain.
The rice should be soft on the outside but hard in the centre.

method.title: Layer into the pan
method.body: Add oil to base of a saucepan + 2 tbsp water. As soon as oil starts to sizzle spoon in enough rice to cover base. Spoon on the rest creating a pyramid shape.

method.title: Poke steam holes
method.body: Poke 5-6 holes down to the base of the pan using a handle of a wooden spoon.

note: Subtitled "- a treat". Marked "CONT" at the foot of the page.

title: Jewelled rice — part 2

method.title: Drizzle with butter
method.body: Mix 2 tbsp of warm water with 40 g of melted butter. Drizzle over rice.

method.title: Seal the pan
method.body:
Wrap the saucepan lid in a clean tea towel & cover the pan as tightly as you can.
Leave pan on medium-high heat until you see puffs of steam escaping from the lid.

method.title: Steam on low
method.body: Turn the heat to low & leave to cook for 40 mins. Resist the temptation to peek as steam will escape. Just make sure the heat is on very low.

method.title: Shock the base
method.body: When ready to serve, sit saucepan in a little cold water to shock rice from the base.

method.title: Make the saffron rice
method.body: Remove 2-3 tbsp of rice & mix with saffron liquid.

method.title: Combine with the jewels
method.body: Gently combine plain rice & the saffron rice with the jewels.

method.title: Press & turn out
method.body: Tip into a basin & press gently but firmly. Turn out onto a serving dish & drizzle with the orange syrup.

method.title: Serve the crunchy base
method.body: Serve crunchy rice pieces from the base of the pan separately.

note: Headed "CONT:" - continuation of the jewelled rice on the previous page.

title: Larp gai salad

method.title: Season the mince
method.body: Mix the mince with the salt & garlic.

method.title: Simmer the mince
method.body:
Heat stock & season with sugar & salt.
Add mince & simmer, stirring often until just cooked - 3-4 mins.
Do not overcook or meat will toughen.

method.title: Season the salad
method.body: Season with lime juice, chilli powder & fish sauce.

method.title: Mix in herbs
method.body: Mix in shallots & herbs.

method.title: Check the seasoning
method.body:
Check seasoning. It should be hot, sour & salty. Adjust if necessary.
Sprinkle with rice flour.

note: Page title is written "Larp gai - salad".
serve_with: Serve with raw vegetables such as chopped cabbage, beans, cucumber, spring onion, lettuce, green tomato & green mango.

title: Michelle's macaroni cheese

method.title: Cook the pasta
method.body: Cook pasta till just al dente.

method.title: Make the cheese sauce
method.body:
Melt butter, add flour for a roux. Add spices & then milk.
Add grated cheese & soup. Do not boil again.

method.title: Fry bacon & vegetables
method.body: Lightly fry bacon, onion & capsicum.

method.title: Combine
method.body: Add to sauce with macaroni/pasta & sauce.

method.title: Bake
method.body:
Place in greased casserole & top with extra cheese.
Cook at 180°C for 30-40 mins.

note: The page heading is written "MICHELE'S MACARONI CHEESE" (one 'l'), though the book's index spells it Michelle's.

title: Mixed grain buddha bowl

items: 4 cups mixed chopped salad vegetables - carrot, cucumber, tomato & beans

method.title: Cook the barley
method.body: Put barley & water in saucepan & cook for 15 minutes. Stand & cover for 10 mins. Drain.

method.title: Cook the quinoa
method.body:
Put quinoa in a sieve & rinse under cold water for 1 min. Transfer to saucepan with stock & bring to boil. Turn heat to low.
Cook for 10 mins then leave to stand for 10 mins. Fluff with fork.

method.title: Shell the edamame
method.body: Soften frozen soy with water then shell.

method.title: Build the bowls
method.body:
Toss with grains, spinach & rocket in a large bowl then arrange in serving bowls.
Top with alfalfa & vegetables then scatter with feta & almonds.

method.title: Make the dressing
method.body:
Combine mayo, oil, juice & tarragon & puree till smooth.
Season then drizzle over salad bowls to serve.

note:
"thks Helen & Jeff" written in the top corner.
Opt: Brown rice with raw salmon & avocado, vegetables, spinach & dressing.

title: Mushroom risotto

method.title: Soften the onion
method.body: In a heavy based pan cook onion in oil over low heat until soft, approximately 3 mins.

method.title: Coat the rice
method.body: Add rice and coat each grain.

method.title: Deglaze with wine
method.body:
Add wine & increase heat - deglaze.
Stir with wooden spoon to stop sticking.

method.title: Add chicken stock
method.body: Add chicken stock & cook for 5 mins until stock is absorbed.

method.title: Chill the par-cooked rice
method.body:
Lay rice on tray, cover with plastic wrap & refrigerate to set.
The rice will last 3-4 days in fridge.

method.title: Heat the mushroom stock
method.body: Bring mushroom stock to the boil & reduce to low.

method.title: Finish the risotto
method.body:
Place the semi-cooked rice in a heavy based saucepan. Add stock just to cover rice.
Add cepes & simmer over medium heat until the rice has absorbed all the stock, stirring occasionally.

method.title: Fold in butter & parmesan
method.body:
Remove from heat, add acid butter & parmesan & gently fold through.
If risotto is too firm, add a little stock. Season & add tarragon.

note: Mushroom stock - see page 192.

title: Pad thai

items: 20 g garlic chives or spring onion
50 g tofu cut into 1 cm cubes

method.title: Fry the garlic
method.body: Heat oil in wok. Add garlic & fry till fragrant.

method.title: Cook chicken & tofu
method.body: Add the chicken, tofu until cooked.

method.title: Add the egg
method.body: Break in egg & spread over chicken.

method.title: Soften the noodles
method.body:
Tip the wok and push cooked food to edge away from heat.
Add noodles & water, stir till softened.

method.title: Season & toss
method.body: Mix noodles with cooked food & season with sugar, fish & oyster sauce.

method.title: Add sprouts & chives
method.body: Add bean sprout & chives.

note:
OPT: Use the egg to make a fine omelet & serve noodles in the egg net. Garnish with sliced chilli/coriander.
She has drawn a small sketch of a wok with the cooked food pushed to the edge and the noodles in the middle.

title: Pasta with seafood & vodka

items: 600 g angel hair, linguine, spaghetti etc
30 ml stock (fish or made from shells)

method.title: Cook the pasta
method.body: Cook the pasta in 6 litres of boiling salted water until just al dente.

method.title: Fry leek & seafood
method.body:
Melt the butter in a skillet and fry the leek till softened. Add the seafood & the saffron. Season.
Cook over medium heat until seafood is just cooked (under is better).

method.title: Add vodka & cream
method.body:
Add vodka, stock & cream & cook until a thick consistency.
(You can reduce the vodka & stock first, then add cream.)

method.title: Toss with the pasta
method.body: Add the drained pasta, a little pasta water to loosen & freshly ground pepper.

method.title: Freshen with lemon
method.body: Freshen with a squeeze of lemon.

note: opt: Deep fried leek can be a garnish.

title: Potato bake

items: Potatoes - peeled or unpeeled, approximately 1 potato per person
1-2 onions - depending on number of potatoes

method.title: Layer the potatoes
method.body:
Thinly slice the potatoes & onions.
In a greased ovenproof dish put a layer of potato to cover the bottom. Sprinkle with a little of the crumbled stock cube & herbs & pepper.

method.title: Continue layering
method.body: Continue layering until ingredients are finished, ending with a potato layer.

method.title: Add water and bake
method.body: Just cover with water & then foil & cook at 180°C for 30-45 mins. Remove foil & cook for another 15 mins.

method.title: Options
method.body:
Use stock instead of cube & water but salt each layer.
Add cheese & paprika.
Add milk instead of water.
Cook in the microwave on 50% covered with plastic wrap for 30 mins.

note: Options listed: use stock instead of cube & water but salt each layer; add cheese & paprika; add milk instead of water; cook in the microwave on 50% covered with plastic wrap for 30 mins.

title: Potato gratin savoyarde

method.title: Preheat the oven
method.body: Preheat oven to 190°C.

method.title: Mix the potatoes
method.body: In a large bowl mix potatoes, pepper, nutmeg, 125 g cheese, egg & warm stock.

method.title: Fill the dish
method.body: Spread over a large flat casserole or baking dish that has been rubbed with garlic & butter.

method.title: Top with cheese
method.body: Spread remaining cheese over the top & dot with little knobs of butter.

method.title: Bake
method.body: Bake for 45-50 mins or until the potatoes are tender & most of the stock has been absorbed.

method.title: Rest before serving
method.body:
Remove from oven & rest for 30 mins.
During this time the rest of the stock will be absorbed.
Don't worry if the egg has coagulated - these little soft curds are an integral part of the pleasure of the dish.

note: Don't worry if the egg has coagulated - these little soft curds are an integral part of the pleasure of the dish.

title: Scallops, gnocchi, chestnuts & sage

method.title: Cook and dry the potato
method.body:
Cook potato slowly. Dry thoroughly.
Pass through a mouli or crush with a fork.

method.title: Make the gnocchi dough
method.body:
Mix flour, salt & pepper and cayenne.
Add egg to potato and add flour slowly and gently. The mix should be light (same as scone dough).

method.title: Shape the gnocchi
method.body: Roll into a 2 cm cylinder and cut gnocchi every 1 cm.

method.title: Cook the gnocchi
method.body: Cook in simmering salted water for 2 minutes. Remove & drain. Place on oiled tray until needed.

method.title: Reduce the stock
method.body: Reduce chicken stock to 450 mls. Add wine. Reduce again till 500 ml remains.

method.title: Cook the peas and onion
method.body: Cover peas, onion with butter & water. Cook till water has evaporated.

method.title: Blanch, sear and finish
method.body: Blanch the asparagus. Sear the scallops then add gnocchi to just colour. Add all ingredients together to heat through.

check: Bintje (potato variety) - written 'Binge/Bintje'

method.title: Steam the shellfish
method.body:
In a heavy saucepan heat 100 ml of olive oil on medium.
Add 10 mussels + 100 ml white wine and 10 clams (or all mussels) & steam for 4-5 mins till they just open. Remove as they do.
Strain & retain the liquor.

method.title: Fry the seafood
method.body:
Add another 100 ml of olive oil to the pan and add the rest of your chosen seafood. Eg: 12 green prawns, 10 scallops, with 4 sliced garlic cloves, 1 small fennel finely chopped, 2 small red chillies finely chopped, 50 g washed salted capers, salt & pepper.
Fry gently for 3 minutes.

method.title: Add calamari and tomato
method.body: Then add 200 g calamari rings and 2 ripe tomatoes sliced thin.

method.title: Simmer in stock
method.body: Add 200 ml of chicken stock and reserved liquor. Simmer for 3-4 mins.

method.title: Finish off the heat
method.body: Remove from heat & add mussels, crabmeat (if using), juice of 1 lemon, bunch of chopped chives & parsley & a drizzle of olive oil.

title: Spiced carrot purée & potato salad

method.title: Cook the carrots
method.body: Cook carrots in chicken stock, with cumin & honey. Drain reserving some cooking liquid.

method.title: Purée and season
method.body: Purée with the bamix & add cream & a dash of cooking liquid. Season.

method.title: Steam the potatoes
method.body: Steam 1 kg of potatoes with their skins on. When cooled slice into 1 cm rounds.

method.title: Dress the potato salad
method.body:
Add 1/2 bunch of sliced spring onion.
Liberally dress with olive oil & salt.

note: From Heidi. Good accompaniment for most dishes. TIP: spiced carrot is excellent as a tapas with trimmed lamb cutlets, dusted with Ras el hanout or baharat & grilled over coals.
serve_with: Good accompaniment for most dishes; spiced carrot is excellent as a tapas with trimmed lamb cutlets dusted with Ras el hanout or baharat & grilled over coals.

title: Sweet rice with chicken, pistachio & bitter orange

items: 2 handfuls of orange peel cut into fine strips

method.title: Wash and soak the rice
method.body: Wash the rice in several changes of water. Soak for 1 hour in cold water and 2 tbsp salt.

method.title: Joint and brown the chicken
method.body:
Joint chicken & pat dry.
Heat oil & sear onion. Add turmeric.
Lay chicken on the onions. Season with salt & pepper and a little saffron.

method.title: Braise the chicken
method.body: Add 60 ml water. Cover and gently braise for 1 1/2 hrs. Add more water if it goes dry.

method.title: Simmer the orange peel
method.body:
In a saucepan dissolve 4 tbsp sugar in 250 ml water. Add orange & simmer for 6 mins. Drain.
(Continued on next page.)

note: Subtitled "Shirin Polo". Continues on the next page (Shirin Polo cont).

title: Shirin polo

method.title: Caramelise the carrots
method.body:
Melt butter in a non-stick pan.
Add the carrots & remaining sugar, caramelise over low heat.

method.title: Add nuts and fruit
method.body: Add the nuts, sultanas, orange & remove from heat.

method.title: Parboil the rice
method.body:
Boil 2-3 litres of water with 1 tbsp salt.
Add drained rice & boil 4-7 mins until al dente. Drain & add a little clarified butter to coat grains.

method.title: Layer the rice
method.body:
Evenly spread the rice thinly over the base of a heavy saucepan.
Add a little carrot mix and then rice, layering until both are used. It should have a conical shape.

method.title: Make steam holes
method.body: With the handle of a wooden spoon make 5 holes that go to bottom of pan.

method.title: Steam the rice
method.body: Wrap the lid in a towel and cover rice, cooking on a very low heat for 80-90 mins. Don't lift lid.

method.title: Mix in the saffron
method.body:
Dissolve the rest of the saffron with a little (3 tbsp) hot water.
When rice is almost cooked, mix in.

method.title: To serve
method.body:
To serve: arrange rice on a large platter & lay chicken pieces on top.
The base of the rice will have a golden crust. Pass this around separately with chicken pan juices.

note: Page headed "Shirin Polo (cont)" - continuation of the previous page (Sweet rice with chicken, pistachio & bitter orange).

title: Thai beef salad

items: 2 small red chillies - very finely chopped

method.title: Marinate the meat
method.body: Combine marinade & meat for 1 hour.

method.title: Build the salad
method.body: Arrange leaves, vermicelli, salad vegetables & herbs in layers on plates.

method.title: Mix the dressing
method.body: Combine dressing & mix well.

method.title: Sear and assemble
method.body: Sear meat on a hot griddle pan or frypan until seared but slightly rare. Arrange on salad & drizzle with dressing.

note: - Gary & Deb -

title: Thai fried rice

method.title: Fry garlic and pork
method.body: Heat oil in wok. Fry garlic, add pork until cooked.

method.title: Add onion and carrot
method.body: Add onion & carrot. Cook 1 min.

method.title: Add the vegetables and egg
method.body:
Add other vegetables except those marked *.
Beat the egg into the wok, stirring continuously.

method.title: Add the rice
method.body: Add rice, scraping to prevent sticking until desired dryness is reached.

method.title: Season and serve
method.body:
Add sauces & sugar. Combine.
Serve with the reserved items (*). Yum.

note: Subtitled "(no soy)". NOTE: Use any vegies you like such as straw mushrooms, corn, diced zucchini, peas, prawns etc. The items marked with a flower symbol (transcribed here as *) are held back and served alongside.

title: Tuscan duro wheat pasta

items: Ratio: 1 egg for 100 g duro wheat flour
Ratio: 50 g spinach & ricotta per person

method.title: Make the dough
method.body:
Measure the duro wheat flour & place in a pile on the bench top, add a pinch of salt, make a well in the middle & add the required no. of eggs to the well.
Mix dough from the inside out, adding more flour if needed, then knead for approximately 15 mins.

method.title: Rest the dough
method.body: Wrap in cling wrap to rest (minimum 15 mins) while you make the filling.

method.title: Make the sage butter sauce
method.body:
Add butter to the pan then the sage.
Sauce is ready when butter starts to brown around the edge of pan.

method.title: Go to rolling the pasta
method.body: Go to: Rolling the pasta.

note: Ratio: 1 egg for 100 g flour. Filling ratio: 50 g spinach & ricotta per person. Go to: Rolling the pasta.

title: Rolling the pasta

method.title: Roll out the dough
method.body:
After resting the pasta dough (see Tuscan duro wheat pasta).
Roll the dough through the pasta machine on setting '1' about 4 times, folding the dough & dusting in flour as needed.

method.title: Thin the sheets
method.body:
Depending on the desired thickness run the dough through setting 1, 3 then 6 (all settings can be used).
Lay sheet of dough on floured bench.

method.title: Ravioli - vege filling
method.body:
Using a ring cutter, make circles of dough. Excess is removed & used for later.
Place small teaspoons of filling in the middle & brush edges with water.
Fold in half, removing any air and finish with a fork around the edge.
Dry for 15 mins on a floured tea towel.

method.title: Tortellini - meat filling
method.body:
Cut squares from dough. Place the filling in the middle & brush edges with water.
Fold in half to make a triangle.

title: Suma's easy tomato chutney

method.title: Prepare the vegetables
method.body:
Peel & finely slice the onions.
Roughly chop the tomatoes.
Deseed & finely slice the chilli.

method.title: Combine & season
method.body: Put all ingredients in a pan & season to taste.

method.title: Simmer until jammy
method.body: Stir well to combine & simmer for 30–40 minutes or until jammy.

method.title: Jar & cool
method.body: Pour into sterilized jars & leave to cool.

note: Suma's recipe. Keeps for up to 4 weeks in the fridge.

title: Tomato & lemongrass sauce for fish

method.title: Blend the spice paste
method.body: Blend spice paste together until smooth.

method.title: Fry the paste
method.body: Heat wok over medium heat with a smear of oil. Fry spice paste with galangal, adding more oil if mix is too dry, for a couple of mins.

method.title: Add water & simmer
method.body: Add water & simmer for 5 mins.

method.title: Add coconut & shallots
method.body: Add coconut & fried shallots & bring to the boil.

method.title: Garnish
method.body: Garnish with shallots (chopped).
